claim_gate.reason: Growing factorial moments close compact adaptive CNOT reparameterizations even with cancellation, but the circuit count is too large for arbitrary dense GL maps.

falsifiers_triggered: A compact label-adaptive CNOT preprocessing cannot expose a polynomial-bond balanced MPS/QTT fiber state.

proof_obligations.statement: Transfer the ordinary growing factorial-moment bound to every affine linear side restriction and arbitrary offset.
Union-bound every source-adaptive compact CNOT transform, its row/column cosets, and all targets.
Control all dense polynomial CNOT transforms, including Theta(q^2)-gate arbitrary GL(m,2) maps.
Construct or obstruct efficiently computable nonlinear maps without a balanced transformed-coordinate cut.

summary: Extended the low-bit fiber entanglement no-go from coordinate permutations to every adaptive sub-q^(4/3) CNOT transform in the stated logarithmic regime, with approximate Schmidt rank 2^(q-o(q)) even allowing matrix cancellation.

theorem.affine_restriction_normal_form: Every affine side restriction is ordinary density-one subset sum in an independent parity-feature basis plus an arbitrary offset g.
theorem.cancellation_aware_schmidt_bound: ||M||^2<=||M||_1||M||_infinity<=T^2, so eta Schmidt mass requires rank at least eta|F|/T^2.
theorem.cnot_family_count: At most 2^m(G+1)(m+1)[m(m-1)]^G affine CNOT circuits and cut choices.
theorem.offset_moment_domination: For each distinct tuple, an inhomogeneous offset equation has zero solutions or one homogeneous-kernel coset, so its factorial moment is at most the ordinary homogeneous moment.
theorem.planted_target_transfer: Independent-target failure 2^-3q absorbs the planted likelihood ratio at most 2^q, leaving failure at most 2^-2q.
theorem.simultaneous_side_cap: For side excess d=O(1), E[(X)_k]<=2^(dk+1). Union over circuits, affine row/column cosets, and targets gives log T=d+O((G log q+q)/k).

theorem_contract.accuracy: Any fixed requested Schmidt mass eta in (0,1].
theorem_contract.architecture: A label/target-adaptive invertible binary linear transform implemented by at most G CNOTs, followed by a balanced transformed-coordinate MPS/QTT cut.
theorem_contract.non_claim: No bound for dense Theta(q^2) linear circuits, nonlinear maps, unbalanced tensor architectures, or general circuits.
theorem_contract.source: m=2q+O(1) independent uniform labels modulo 2^q, under independent or planted target law.
